isolation.purpose: execute MODEL-WRITTEN native-build code ONLY in an outer isolated process; the host never compiles/executes it
reuses: provider-sandbox.runProvider/buildBwrapArgs (bubblewrap --unshare-all/--clearenv/minimal ro binds/--info-fd launch proof/prlimit RLIMIT_AS) — no second sandbox
odg-local-model-benchmark.defaultCodeRunner + parseResult + CTX_ASSERT_SRC (#898 pattern: null-prototype vm context inside bwrap, per-run nonce, JSON observations only)
invariants: only DATA crosses: file sources + test inputs in; a nonce-stamped JSON verdict/observations out; model code has no stdout/process/require
sandbox unavailable / probe failed ⇒ NOT_RUN (verified=null) — NEVER a silent in-process fallback
a launched run without a well-formed nonce-stamped result (crash, OOM, timeout, garbage, forgery) ⇒ NON-pass
no network (--unshare-all), cleared env, no repo/home bind, tmpfs /tmp, RLIMIT_AS 1 GiB, per-step vm timeout + process timeout
CASES form: expected values stay on the host (host-graded). SOURCE form: test runs in the candidate realm (tamper-equivalent to the legacy in-thread test — stated, not hidden)

method: Same code evaluated by both paths: IN_PROCESS = native-project-builder.assembleAndLoad + the corpus host-function test (legacy, now opt-in UNISOLATED); ISOLATED = odg-native-build-sandbox.runIsolated (bwrap --unshare-all/--clearenv + prlimit RLIMIT_AS 1GiB + null-prototype vm; test serialized via testSourceFromFn). Wall time per evaluation (isolated includes bwrap+node process start).

deterministic.note: every corpus task's REFERENCE implementation (expected PASS) + a BROKEN_ENTRY variant (expected FAIL)

modelGenerated.transport: Ollama loopback 127.0.0.1:11434 (generation on the host; ONLY execution sandboxed)

BLOCKED:A dynamic import callback was not specified.

honestLimits: SOURCE-form test runs in the candidate's realm (tamper-equivalent to the legacy in-thread test, not stronger); the CASES form is host-graded.

inside the sandbox generated code may require only other generated files or 'assert' (in-context shim); the #913 in-process allowlist also allowed util/events/string_decoder — such code builds in-process but fails isolated (REQUIRE_DENIED) — any such case appears as a divergence above.
wall time includes per-evaluation bwrap + node startup; measured on a shared host.
